declarations.semanticEquivalent: The Python SessionPolicy maps the Rust Record action to the lowercase authoring name and back to the native enum spelling.

Python Policy.observe serializes the native ObservePolicy schema; defaults remain absent and disabled, recording rules add independently bounded outputs, and native-tab capture is a separate explicit permission.
Python screenshot region and target models retain the native tagged JSON forms, and the result pairs serializable capture metadata with a typed ImageDocument.
Each Python handle owns one recording output, stop returns typed video documents and timeline gaps, and a hard native duration bound reaps abandoned capture.
The Python snapshot retains automatic captures and explicit gaps keyed to operation receipts while keeping image bytes in native ImageDocument owners.

Completed automatic outputs remain typed and readable after Session close; video segments and payload-free settled receipt markers remain separately typed, with lost_action_events preserving watch gaps.
Recording manifests reference raw archived video documents and restore their exact bytes, timing, gaps, stop reason, and settled receipt markers without restoring live browser authority.
Recording actions preserve payload-free settled receipt markers and their observed timestamps, while lost_action_events reports bounded watch loss.
Screenshot manifests reference raw archived image documents and preserve operation links and explicit gaps without restoring Session authority.
